convertibility_reason: Hedging logic opens opposite positions without SL/TP, tracks hedged positions by ID in a dynamic array, uses CTrade/CPositionInfo/CSymbolInfo/CAccountInfo wrapper classes from Trade .mqh libraries, and lot sizing is derived from existing position volume multiplied by a coefficient - requires careful state management for the hedged_positions tracker and cooldown timer

other_exits: No SL/TP set on hedge positions - explicit warning in source code that EA has no stop loss or take profit
Hedge positions are opened as protection only with SL=0 and TP=0

position_sizing.conditional_logic: hedge_lot = LotCheck(existing_position_volume * InpLotCoefficient). Coefficient-based sizing: multiplies the losing position's volume by a configurable coefficient (1.0-3.0), then normalizes to broker lot constraints (step, min, max). If result is below LotsMin, returns 0 and trade is skipped.

custom_logic_notes: This is a hedging EA, not a signal-based EA. It monitors existing positions (filtered by magic number and symbol) and when a position's floating loss exceeds the configurable threshold in pips, it opens an opposite hedge position. Key logic: (1) One-hedge-per-position: tracks position IDs in hedged_positions[] array to prevent re-hedging. (2) Cooldown: InpCooldownMinutes between hedge trades. (3) Max hedges limit: InpMaxHedges caps total hedges (0=unlimited). (4) Hedge positions are excluded from monitoring by checking against InpHedgeMagicNumber. (5) Margin safety: requires 80% free margin remaining after hedge. (6) Symbol filter: only hedges positions on current chart symbol. (7) Digit adjustment: point_adjust=10 for 3/5-digit symbols, 1 otherwise. (8) No SL/TP on any positions - explicitly warned as demo-only EA.
python_conversion_notes: Requires maintaining a hedged_positions set (use Python set of position IDs) and last_hedge_time timestamp for cooldown. Position monitoring loop iterates all open positions each tick. Loss-in-pips calculation needs digit-aware point adjustment (multiply by 10 for 3/5-digit). Lot normalization must respect broker min/step/max constraints. Margin check uses 80% free margin threshold. The CTrade/CPositionInfo/CSymbolInfo/CAccountInfo wrappers map to basic broker API calls (get positions, place market orders, get symbol info, check margin). No indicators to convert. Key challenge: the position-tracking state (hedged_positions array) must persist across ticks and be serializable for backtesting. Since hedge positions have no SL/TP, the backtest engine must handle positions without exit rules.
